bullets.content: [general] One untested factor per solve: before each mesh() write the diff vs the last solved mesh; if more than one item, split it across solves. Then compare(prev,new) with two different ids. After every solve view(kind=error) and list top-5 hotspot local h vs requested size; if h >1.3x request, the box missed or was swallowed: move or shrink it.

[general] Never leave a solve unused (repeated: 2 unused). Use the last solve for the strongest open single factor, then compare(best, runner-up). Use bold structural changes (move boxes to the error band, moving >=5% of nodes into the hotspot band), not 5% DOF variations; skip candidates within +-3% nodes of a known solve.

[general] Point refinements {point,size,radius} changed nothing (a4: 7 points left nodes 5882-5934; a7: identical 5661). Use thin boxes (e.g. 4x10x2.6 mm). Mesh with and without each new refinement; drop it if nodes change <1%.
[general] After every solve view(kind=error, iso) and tabulate top-3 hotspot local h vs the requested size of the containing box. If h >=1.2x request, that box's size is the next lever.

[general] Diversity needs a structural difference in the DELIVERED mesh: h 0.015 vs 0.0095 with identical boxes gave the same median h and no bonus. Differ by refinement targets or order when boxes dominate nodes.

[general] Boxes and groups deliver ~1.3-1.4x the requested size (0.0022→0.0028, 0.0024→0.0031). Request 0.7x the h needed; after each solve view(kind=error, iso) and compare hotspot h vs request. If >1.3x (edge 40: 0.0028 asked, 0.0044-0.0047 got), the refinement missed: don't submit it.

[general] Reference-free estimate was 1.5x optimistic (8.2% vs true 12.2%). If estimate x1.5 > 0.9x target, do not submit; spend the remaining solve on a finer hot band. Never leave a solve unused: use the last for a controlled experiment and compare against the best.

[general] Clamp-plus-bending parts: error concentrates within ~1-3 mm of the clamped face, under the load. Refine a thin slab there (size ≈0.15-0.2x thickness) rather than whole thickness or whole faces.
[general] Before solving, compare node count with previous mesh. A change under ~1% means the refinement was a no-op (box 0.0042: 5716 vs 5722 nodes). Refine to ≤0.7x the local size instead.
[general] Before submit, compare(cheapest, finest). If diff ≤~12% and energy gain is below the relative DOF rise, submit the cheaper solve. Never pick by a guessed asymptotic energy.
[general] One factor per solve: when testing a replacement (ring boxes for f2 group), ADD the new item keeping the old; swap only if the old is proven useless. A swap confounded two changes.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Setup verified repeatedly (3d, fixed f12, pressure 2.1e6 Pa on f7, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3); reactions and energy consistent. Reuse verbatim; error is at features.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Root band (z -0.0081..-0.0055, x 0.016-0.030, y -0.016..0.014) holds ~40% of error. Box 0.0024 gave hotspot h 0.0031, 0.0022 gave 0.0028. Request thin slab z<-0.005 at 0.0017-0.0018 r0.002; verify hotspot h ≤0.0025 in error map.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] a7: two small root boxes at 0.0018 (x 0.0185-0.0215 and 0.0245-0.0285, z -0.0081..-0.0055) cut field error 8.91%→8.50% for +1% DOFs. Thin clamp slab is the most efficient lever. a3 (8.91%, 16983 DOFs) used box z -0.0081..-0.004 at 0.0022.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Never omit {group:f7,size≤0.0035}; put it in the FIRST mesh (without it: lowest energy 2.0981e-4, 9.9% field change; box-only also lost energy). Do not re-test.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Cover f5 mid-wall with box [0.012,-0.02,-0.004,0.021,0.013,0.0081] at 0.0035 r0.003; without it the wall cell near f5 (x≈0.015,z≈0.002) was 11% below consensus.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Pocket: use box [0.016,0.012,-0.0081,0.026,0.03,-0.003] at 0.003 r0.003, not 0.0035 up to z 0 (f38 h 0.0037 vs peers 0.0034-0.0036). It also covers f4-side root hotspot.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Keep upper -y box [0.016,-0.025,0,0.03,-0.012,0.0081] at 0.003 r0.003: +0.39% SE for +178 nodes (fixes upper-wall hotspots near f9).

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Keep f5 group dropped: it cost 774 nodes for 0.22% SE and spilled onto low-error faces f10,f11,f14,f26-f34. Boxes cover f5 cheaper (energy 2.1239e-4 without it). Retest with coarser global h.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] h 0.009 with f7 0.0035 r0.004 gives min quality 0.177-0.276 vs 0.112 for h 0.007 box recipes. Keep h 0.009: structural distinction from peers, safe margin for fine slabs.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Scan mesh() node count before every solve; stay ≤6000 nodes (18k DOFs). If over, raise slab to 0.002, then narrow its y to -0.012..0.013. Never solve just to see node count.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] After each solve view(kind=error, view='-x') and read hotspot h at f5/f7 root. Compare the two real submission candidates, not a decided pair. Submit by est. score (energy plus eta, e≈1.4×eta, hotspot h ≤0.0028).
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Plan for 4 solves: S1 recipe as given; S2 slab 0.0017→0.0015 only; S3 coarser global h 0.011 only, compare(1,3); S4 best variant. Cap ~17k DOFs (≤5800 nodes).
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] DOFs bind (cost 0.48-0.50 vs accuracy 1.19-1.22). Upper half <3% of error. Test global h 0.011-0.012 with same root slab (~13k DOFs) as a one-factor experiment.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Edge 18 (f5∩f12) is ~87 mm long; at 0.003 r0.004 it refines the whole clamp perimeter (18.3k DOFs) yet stays coarse at hotspots. Replace with points or a box over y -0.012..0.012 only.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Older edge recipe (superseded by boxes): edge 22 at 0.0022 with f7 0.0035 r0.005 gave energy 2.124e-4. Edge 22 joins f7/f12; never raise it. Edge 18 (f5∩f12) at 0.0025-0.003 is costly: prefer boxes.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Dropping pocket f38/f39 refinement (x 0.02-0.03, y 0.012-0.03, z<0) left hotspot h 0.0061, 12% vM error (~10% of energy). Keep a pocket box (see 0.003 box) or f38 0.004 r0.004.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] A refinement must be finer than local h at hotspots (0.0041-0.0068) and grow over ≥0.003. Box at 0.0045 radius 0.001 changed nothing.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Face refinements must be finer than natural size: f5/f9 at 0.005 added ~250 nodes, error stayed ~12%. Drop f9.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Small faces f10/f11/f26-f32/f34 reached h 0.0029-0.0033 (a7: 0.0043-0.0045) with negligible error. If that recurs, find edge refinements spilling onto them and remove them.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Low-stress cells near f52 (y≈-0.037) and f13 (vm<3.6e5 Pa, spread 3-5%) carry negligible energy; don't spend DOFs there.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Edges 15, 24, 18 at 0.004 bought nothing (field error 15.8%); superseded by edge 18 at 0.0025 radius 0.004 in the recipe only if verified. Spend DOFs in the bottom band near f5/f7.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Check points: P2 (near f13) off by 12-13%, hidden worst (~9-11%) near f12/f52 (y≈-0.0375, h 0.0069). Test cheap f52 at 0.005 radius 0.008 to cut check-point RMS.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Energy ranked solves correctly (2.0981→2.1101→2.1157→2.1240e-4; submitted gave 10.1%). Submit by energy plus eta, but compute est. score (e≈1.4×eta) and check hotspot h ≤0.0028 first; confirm with compare.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Spend a solve on one factor: slab 0.0017→0.0015 (same radius). Submit if compare shows change at the root, energy rises, DOFs grow <15%.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Setup verified: 3d, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3, fixed f12, pressure 2.1e6 on f7. All remaining error is discretisation at f5/f7 root band.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Meshing is deterministic: don't re-solve a1's control (8591 nodes, 0.033815 J, field 16.04%). S1 upper box 0.0040; S2 bracket 0.0036 or 0.0044; S3 best upper with saddles 0.0022; S4 best combo. One size per solve; reject qmin<0.15 or folded_cells≠0.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Setup (3d, f2 fixed, 4e6 Pa on f23, 2.1e6 Pa on f16, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3) is fine; reuse verbatim. Diversity from h alone failed (see general).

[abc_00000003_bc7] Global h above 0.0095 is inert in the box recipe: h 0.012 gave 8014 nodes, 0.015 8009, 0.018 7907 (qmin 0.109). h 0.015 lost 0.19% energy, P3 -13%, P2 +7%. Never spend a solve on h >0.0095 here.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp-ring hotspots (z≈0.056 by f20, ~20% of error, h 0.0044-0.0046; self: 22-24% vM, P1 -18.8%) are sized by the upper box at 0.0048, not f2. Test upper box 0.0040 (or thin z 0.048-0.0605 at 0.0033); aim hotspot h ≤0.0039. a2 coarsening to 0.0055 lost 0.26%; break-even +10% nodes needs +0.27% energy.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Free-mesh the upper 0.0040 first: if nodes >9900 use 0.0042; if qmin <0.15 shift size by 0.0002. Afterwards confirm f20/f2 element size near <0.0042.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Saddle boxes [±0.010..±0.017, y±0.012, z 0.019-0.030] at 0.0026-0.0027 r0.002 pay: +0.27% energy for +5.2% nodes. Keep in base. a1 saddle hotspot still h 0.00327, 14.7% error. Use a1's mesh as base (field 16.04%, points 6.47%) and change exactly one size.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Lower-barrel check points P2/P3 (z≈0.007) are sensitive to grading from lower box 0.0046: h 0.015 gave P3 -13.1%, P2 +7.0%; h 0.0095 gave +1.7%, +0.02%. Watch them when changing sizes at z<0.021.
